# Icon themes

Subsets of freedesktop icon themes: only the icons OpsRemote uses (actions, folders, and SFTP file types). Files are copied unmodified from the pinned upstream releases below, after checking that each is a plain, single SVG drawing. Refresh them with `scripts/internal/update-icon-themes.py`.

| Theme | Release | Icons | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Breeze | v6.31.0 | 111 | LGPL-3.0-or-later | https://codeload.github.com/KDE/breeze-icons/tar.gz/refs/tags/v6.31.0 |
| Papirus | 20260801 | 119 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/PapirusDevelopmentTeam/papirus-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/20260801 |
| Papirus Dark | 20260801 | 119 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/PapirusDevelopmentTeam/papirus-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/20260801 |
| Adwaita | 51.0 | 46 | LGPL-3.0 (dual-licensed with CC-BY-SA-3.0; used under LGPL-3.0) | https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/adwaita-icon-theme/-/archive/51.0/adwaita-icon-theme-51.0.tar.gz |
| Yaru | r29 | 34 | CC-BY-SA-4.0 / GPL-3.0 | https://codeload.github.com/ubuntu/yaru/tar.gz/refs/tags/r29 |
| Tela | 2026-07-07 | 76 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/vinceliuice/Tela-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/2026-07-07 |
| Fluent | 2026-07-27 | 92 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/vinceliuice/Fluent-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/2026-07-27 |
| Colloid | 2026-08-10 | 80 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/vinceliuice/Colloid-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/2026-08-10 |
| Qogir | 2025-02-15 | 92 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/vinceliuice/Qogir-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/2025-02-15 |
| WhiteSur | 2026-09-10 | 96 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/vinceliuice/WhiteSur-icon-theme/tar.gz/refs/tags/2026-09-10 |
| elementary | 9.0.0 | 65 | GPL-3.0-only | https://codeload.github.com/elementary/icons/tar.gz/refs/tags/9.0.0 |

Each theme's folder contains its upstream license files. Icons a theme does not provide fall back to the application's built-in icons.
